mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 6% and PAYEMS increases by > 200k over 3 months, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:strong labor markets boost consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.05 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances productivity and efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of non-recession quarters with positive INDPRO growth, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 6-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST, signaling strengthened housing demand, positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, especially during early-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of early-cycle months with positive HOUST growth, or Rank IC < 0.035 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds its 6-month moving average, indicating rising inflation expectations, and FEDFUNDS is below 1%, investors anticipate monetary policy adjustments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.02 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, the level of UNRATE, as a standalone indicator of labor market health, has a positive influence on S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, with lower rates indicating stronger returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window, or SPX returns do not show significant negative correlation with UNRATE levels (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS increases by > 5% month-over-month, signaling a surge in retail sales, and GDPC1 is above its 12-month moving average, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 5 trading days, but only during late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered late-cycle instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.04 over any 5-year rolling window.
